title: MPLS Dev Summit — Staff Wallet, Logistics & Expense Scratchpad
content:
Quick scratchpad for staff-facing ops at the Minneapolis Dev Summit (MPLS). Purpose: keep on-site cash/card flow clear, vendor contacts handy, and last-minute reminders in one place. Not polished — notes to self and action items.

Summary / Goals:
- Make check-in+badge distribution <10min/person for staff shift handoffs.
- Prevent lost receipts and speed reimbursements (aim: reimburse within 7 business days).
- Avoid card friction for taxis/last-mile and food. Keep one petty-cash float and one preloaded corporate card per 6 staff.

Key dates:
- Staff arrive: 2025-11-10 (evening) — hotel: The Freight House (room block: Redwood Tech)
- Setup day: 2025-11-11 (08:00–18:00) — vendor load-in 09:00
- Summit day: 2025-11-12 (09:00–20:00)
- Tear down: 2025-11-12 (20:00–22:30)

Hotel / Check-in notes:
- Block under "Redwood Tech — Dev Summit" (pickup code: RWD1125). Front desk contact: Jenna, +1-612-555-0189. Rooming list has been sent (see confluence:DEV-SUMMIT-2025-PLAYBOOK).
- Staff early check-in: ask for rollaway hold in case of late arrivals. Keep a printed spreadsheet at registration desk with last 4 of credit card on file for incidentals.

Wallet + cards plan (working):
- Float A (petty cash): $800 in envelopes for incidentals, tips, on-the-spot vendor cash (label each envelope by team: registration, AV, hospitality). Keep safe with Event Lead (Priya).
- Corporate preloaded cards: 3 x $1,200 virtual cards (for catering, last-mile shuttles, emergency rentals). Card owners = Diego, Liam, Maya. Add transaction memos with ticket numbers or vendor invoice IDs.
- Staff on-site expense policy: if possible, use corporate card. If staff uses personal card, must submit receipt + short note in expense sheet within 48h. Per-diem food cap: $65/day on event day (breakfast covered by hotel).

Receipt capture / reimbursements:
- Use Expensr app (company default). Quick steps: snap -> tag (MPLS-SUMMIT) -> expense type (meals, taxi, supplies) -> submit.
- Paper receipts allowed but must be photographed same day. If receipt lost: staff to file "lost receipt" form and note approximate amount + approver (Priya).
- Reimbursements target SLA: 7 business days after submission. Escalation: Maya -> finance@redwood.com if >10 days.

Vendors & contacts (essential):
- BadgeForge (badging + lanyards) — primary contact: Tara K. / tara@badgeforge.com / +1-612-555-1144. Delivery window: 08:30 on 11/11. Confirm final qty by 11/02.
- NorthLoop Shuttle (hotel <> venue shuttles) — ops lead: Omar / ops@northloopshuttle.com / +1-612-555-2022. Note: confirm wheelchair access for 2 pickups.
- Aster Logistics (day-of freight + storage) — contact: Michelle Park / michelle@asterlogistics.co / +1-847-555-3300. Bill to Redwood PO EVT-3421 (see JIRA).
- Local AV partner: SoundMint Events — tech lead: Raj / raj@soundmint.com / +1-612-555-6006. Onsite arrival: 07:30 11/11. Run-of-show v2 attached in confluence.
- Coffee/Break catering: Wild Bean Co. — estimate invoice to be < $1,500. Contact: Hannah / hannah@wildbean.co / +1-612-555-2233. Need vegan milk callouts.

Transportation (staff):
- Prebook rides for execs: RSVP sheet lists arrival times. Use corporate rides account where possible.
- Ride-share float: keep 2 backup Uber credits on Diego and Liam cards for emergency pickups.
- For heavy freight from hotel to venue at load-in, Aster Logistics handles; tip envelope in petty cash for bellhop (label: tips).

On-site desk checklist (registration):
- Tablet + charger (backup battery) x2, printed attendee list, spare name badges (50), Sharpies, tape, scissors, cash float envelope (Reg Team).
- Registration staff schedule: 08:00–12:30 (shift A), 12:30–18:00 (shift B). Each shift: 3 people. Shift leads: Priya (A), Diego (B).

Expense categories & codes (for finance):
- Meals: EVT-MEAL
- Taxi/Shuttle: EVT-TRANS
- Supplies (badges/stationery): EVT-SUPP
- AV/Tech: EVT-AV
- Freight & Storage: EVT-FREIGHT
- Incidentals/tips: EVT-MISC
(Important: require invoice or receipt for all >$25)

Known open items / questions (action owner):
- Badge qty confirmation from BadgeForge (Priya) — due 2025-11-02.
- Final invoice estimates from Wild Bean Co. (Maya) — due 2025-11-04.
- Confirm shuttle pick-up windows with NorthLoop (Diego) — due 2025-10-29.
- Add wheelchair-accessible signage at venue entrances (Liam) — check with venue facilities.
- Confirm which staff need parking passes (list to Jenna at hotel).

Notes to self / day-of hacks:
- Print 1 extra copy of rooming list for AV lead — sometimes hotel needs to match names on bill.
- Keep sticky notes and small zip bags for tangled cables / lost badge storage.
- Put a "lost & found" bin at registration and log items; hand over to hotel lost & found at close.
- If a vendor asks for partial cash on delivery, route through Event Lead first — avoid handing out petty cash without sign-off.

Post-event wrap (timelines):
- Day +1: collect all remaining petty cash receipts, count float, photo evidence, and submit petty-cash reconciliation (Priya).
- Day +3: all staff must upload receipts to Expensr and tag with EVT code.
- Day +7: finalize final invoices, hand to finance with PO references.

Emergency / escalation contacts:
- On-site security (venue): +1-612-555-0900
- Event Lead (Priya Sharma): +1-415-555-0123
- Backup Event Ops (Diego Alvarez): +1-408-555-0198
- Finance ops (reimbursements): finance@redwood.com

Free-form notes / scribbles:
- Consider having a small stash of branded stickers for staff to hand out if swag runs low.
- Double-check allergies for VIP lunch table (list in confluence).
- If rain forecast: move outdoor signage to under awning and protect badges in zip bags.
- Delegate a single person to handle vendor invoices during teardown (Maya volunteer?).

Last-minute reminders (on day-of):
- Charge all radios + phones overnight.
- Put spare name badge lanyards in tech kit.
- Mark the three corporate cards with colored tape (to avoid confusion).

End of scratchpad. Will copy final checklist to confluence once items settled.
